patch_description: Add a final constrained maximin polishing pass on the best multistart result. The existing smooth-force stages are effective at locating a strong contact graph, but they only approximate the nonsmooth ratio objective. This pass fixes the diameter to at most one and directly maximizes an auxiliary minimum squared-distance variable subject to every pairwise constraint \(t \leq d_{ij}^2 \leq 1\). It supplies analytic constraint Jacobians, avoids relying on finite differences, and retains the original point set whenever the constrained solver does not produce an exact-score improvement. The import is local with a fallback, preserving operation in environments without SciPy.
